name: @ardia/ardiacore
description: The web engine for React Native macOS via Expo Modules: Chrome's own framework from our patched Chromium with our layer (engine/ardiacore), hosting Chrome tabs in the app's views.

scripts.test: bash scripts/adnauseam.sh && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-zoom.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ardiacore-pip-zoom-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ardiacore-pip-zoom-test" && clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Werror tests/pip-throw.test.cc -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ardiacore-pip-throw-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ardiacore-pip-throw-test" && node --test tests/content-blocker-clicks.test.mjs tests/adnauseam-clicks.test.mjs
